summary: The image illustrates the architecture of a Transformer model, featuring two main components: the encoder and decoder. The encoder consists of multiple layers (N×) that include 'Add & Norm', 'Feed Forward', and 'Multi-Head Attention' blocks. The decoder mirrors this structure but includes a 'Masked Multi-Head Attention' block to prevent attending to future tokens. Positional encoding is applied to both input and output embeddings to retain the order of the sequence. The output probabilities are generated through a linear layer followed by a softmax function.
